title: 面向大规模动态图的图神经网络优化机制研究

novelty_points.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，通过图摘要技术将动态时序图压缩为固定规模的新图，解决GNN输出无法直接输入RNN训练的问题，并利用图自编码器与循环神经网络学习时序特征。
novelty_points.claim_en: Propose a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method GSAERU based on graph summarization, which compresses dynamic sequential graphs into fixed-size new graphs via graph summarization, addressing the issue that GNN outputs cannot be directly fed into RNN training, and uses a graph autoencoder and a recurrent neural network to learn temporal features.
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻原图快照的序列
通过图摘要技术对原图进行压缩，生成固定规模的新图
将压缩后的新图输入图自编码器，利用与原图的重构误差训练原图节点的表征
将单时间步上的图表征输入循环神经网络，学习时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系
technical_features_en: Model dynamic sequential graphs as a sequence of snapshots of the original graph at each time step
Compress the original graph via graph summarization to generate a fixed-size new graph
Input the compressed new graph into a graph autoencoder and train node representations using reconstruction error with the original graph
Feed the graph representations at each time step into a recurrent neural network to learn temporal features and dependencies

作者贡献段1：提出了一种新的图表示学习模型——GSAERU...

novelty_points.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练算法DSGNN，采用领导-工作者模式，由领导节点进行图划分，工作节点基于图摘要进行小批量训练，并通过注意力层返回结果，实现分布式训练加速。
novelty_points.claim_en: Propose a distributed graph neural network optimization training algorithm DSGNN based on graph summarization, adopting a leader-worker mode where the leader partitions the graph, workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization, and results are returned through an attention layer, accelerating distributed training.
technical_features: 采用“领导——工作者”工作模式
领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分并分配子图
工作节点执行基于图摘要技术的小批量训练
训练结果通过注意力层返回给领导节点
领导节点汇总结果并计算梯度，同步更新所有计算节点上的模型
technical_features_en: The leader partitions the original graph using a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation and assigns subgraphs
Workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization technology
Training results are returned to the leader through an attention layer
The leader aggregates results, computes gradients, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes

作者贡献段2：提出了一种新的基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络训练框架，称为DSGNN...

novelty_points.claim: 提出一种基于边分割的图流划分算法Sketch-DBH，利用Count-Min Sketch概率数据结构存储节点度数信息，并使用最小堆维护高频节点信息，实现常数时间内返回查询结果并生成子图编号，确保负载均衡。
novelty_points.claim_en: Propose a graph flow partition algorithm Sketch-DBH based on edge segmentation, which uses the Count-Min Sketch probabilistic data structure to store node degree information and a min-heap to maintain high-frequency node information, enabling constant-time query results and generating subgraph IDs while ensuring load balance.
technical_features: 基于边分割的图流划分算法
通过Count-Min Sketch概率数据结构存储每个节点的度数信息
使用最小堆维护图流数据中的高频节点信息
在常数时间内返回查询结果
根据节点度数信息生成单条图流数据即将被分配到的子图编号
technical_features_en: Graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation
Store node degree information using the Count-Min Sketch probabilistic data structure
Use a min-heap to maintain high-frequency node information in graph streams
Return query results in constant time
Generate the subgraph ID to which each graph stream item will be assigned based on node degree information
